update_reason: Iteration 3: resolved reviewer findings PRD-R2-001..003 in place (.v1 filenames retained) — added a validating AC for BR-11 (plan must have >=2-3 items incl. >=1 AI-enabled) the §8 compliance metric depends on, the plan-selection enforcement/error journey + remove-swap flow, and specified+tested the optional manager 'endorsed' catalog flag. (Iteration 2) resolved PRD-R1-001..007 in place. (Prior) Product owner approved v1 at the gate and introduced 5 new MVP requirements: real Google OAuth (NULogic-restricted) replacing fake-auth-only, baseline current-skill capture, employee self-service skill management, manager approval workflow, and resume upload + Claude extraction.

reviewer_findings_resolved_iteration3.resolution: Added AC-26 (P1) validating BR-11: a conforming upskilling plan (>=2 items incl. >=1 AI-enabled) is accepted and counts toward the §8 compliance metric; a non-conforming plan is rejected with a specific message and not marked complete; remove/swap-to-conformance covered. AI-enabled reuses the catalog Claude tag (BR-07). Added a coverage_matrix row mapping BR-11 -> AC-26. Clarified BR-11 Impact to reference AC-26 and the enforcement flow.

Documented the plan-validation user journey in PRD §3 UC-1 (explicit rule, user-facing rejection messages for <2 items and 0 AI-enabled, and a remove/swap-item path), and mirrored it as a new §10 Error-Handling 'Plan selection (UC-1)' row plus a §10 edge case.

Specified the optional manager 'endorsed' catalog flag (kept in-scope): manager/HR/Admin may set/unset it, non-managers are denied, endorsed items are surfaced/indicated in catalog + recommendations; flag-only (no workflow). Added BR-22 + AC-27 (P2) + coverage_matrix row; clarified PRD UC-5, §10, scope-boundary In-Scope/quality-gates and reaffirmed endorsement workflows remain OUT.

reviewer_findings_resolved.resolution: Defined single-identity skill model: one canonical record per profile, trust state PROMOTES in place (self-reported -> manager-approved -> verified), never duplicates the row; re-asserting/approving/cert-verifying promotes the same record. Hero loop before/after compares the same promoted record. Added BR-18, AC-22; tightened AC-07, BR-15, PRD §4/UC-3.

Specified deterministic OAuth-identity -> synthetic-profile mapping via a seeded table keyed by a synthetic handle (NOT real email/PII); same identity resolves to same synthetic profile every time, making AC-14 deterministically testable. Real email used only transiently for hosted-domain check, never stored. Added BR-13a; tightened AC-14, PRD UC-6.

Added session-expiry / re-auth-mid-flow handling: expired session redirects to sign-in, in-flight unsaved work handled gracefully, no protected data on stale session. Added BR-20, AC-24, PRD UC-6b + NFR + error-handling row.

Defined idempotent / de-duplicated double-submit handling for cert AND resume uploads (no duplicate skill records / promotions / pre-populations). Added BR-19, AC-23, PRD NFR + error-handling/edge-case + UC notes.

Admin role management made explicit: minimal in-scope (Admin assigns/overrides a user's role); broader config explicitly deferred to roadmap in scope-boundary. Added BR-21, AC-25, UC-10, persona update.

Added partial-quantity staffing fulfillment: when fewer than the requested count qualify, return those that do with a clear shortfall note (not zero-fit). Added AC-21 + PRD error-handling row + edge case.
Added a resume-parse success metric to PRD §8 success-metrics for symmetry with the cert-parse metric.
